end.parentNote: Asha practised place-value multiplication and the doubling-and-halving method with Sameer. Sameer used known facts such as 10 × 10 = 100 and 25 × 4 = 100, and in the final example they changed 25 × 16 to 50 × 8 and got 400. Earlier, they doubled both numbers instead of doubling one and halving the other; this was not fully corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, practise a few examples by circling the factor being doubled and halving the other, such as 25 × 16 → 50 × 8.
